name: Walking As Christ
overview: Scripture calls believers to imitate Christ by following His example of sacrificial love and humble obedience, as Jesus Himself commanded in John 13:15. The Christian life is marked by being conformed to Christ’s image (Romans 8:29) and living by faith in Him who lives within us (Galatians 2:20). Walking as Christ means adopting His mindset (Philippians 2:5), living in continual dependence on Him (Colossians 2:6), and being devoted followers of God as His beloved children (Ephesians 5:1). This walk is a tangible expression of the new life received through faith in Jesus Christ.
